title: Democratic Policy Development using Collective Dialogues and AI

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring and comparing the level of support for AI policy guidelines across different age groups (18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55+) using a max-min bridging agreement metric to ensure representativeness.
Measuring and comparing the level of support for AI policy guidelines across gender identities (Male, Female, Other) to ensure equitable consensus and representativeness.
Measuring and comparing the level of support for AI policy guidelines across religious affiliations (Christian, Non-christian religious, Non-religious) using bridging support metrics.
Measuring and comparing the level of support for AI policy guidelines across racial groups (White, Black, Other) to ensure no single demographic's support is disproportionately low.
Measuring and comparing the level of support for AI policy guidelines across educational attainment levels (High school or less, College/Bachelors, Masters/PhD or equivalent).

Measuring and comparing the level of support for AI policy guidelines across political affiliations (Democrat, Independent, Republican) to evaluate bridging consensus and prevent political polarization in the policy.
